summary: Customer runs a water-based emulsion polymerisation in a 2 m3 stirred batch reactor at about 80 °C and wants to follow residual monomer in-line during the feed instead of taking lab samples. Product is milky white. They ask which spectroscopic method and probe to test first. Additional facts: target is butyl acrylate, roughly 0.5 to 8 wt% during the feed, lab reference is GC. No optical brighteners; an anionic surfactant and a persulfate initiator are used.
